emotions.desc: Suspense, dark pacts, unseen threats, and psychological weight.
Real-world texture: boots on damp dirt, armor clinks, timber, wind, and rain.
Visceral scythe weight, bone-shattering impacts, and monstrous force.
Otherworldly runes, soul whispers, relics, and elemental spellcraft.
High-BPM combat drive, fast dashes, and survival pressure.
Solitude, tragic memories, quiet night air, and forsaken ruins.
Star-Fire light, Candora's grace, and heroic resolve.

environments.desc: Damp soil, midnight canopy, wind through boughs, and distant beasts.
Roaring embers, collapsing timber, smoke, and tragic memory.
Cold flagstone, echoing crypts, iron gates, and ancient shrines.
Sub-bass abyssal pressure, Andras's pact, and bullet-time overdrive.
High-stakes showdowns, lethal telegraphs, and heavy steel clashes.
Grimoire pages, relic reveals, chapter banners, and notifications.

neutral.name: Raw / Unbent (Original)
neutral.feeling: Exact source file with no coloration.

grounded_forest_step.name: Grounded Damp Forest Step
grounded_forest_step.feeling: Warm, physical boot-on-soil weight; removes harsh digital click so footsteps feel planted in the Dark Forest.

heavy_scythe_weight.name: Cursed Scythe Massive Weight
heavy_scythe_weight.feeling: Drops pitch 4 semitones and adds saturation grit so a standard sword swing feels like a heavy demonic scythe.

brutal_bone_impact.name: Visceral Bone-Crushing Impact
brutal_bone_impact.feeling: Hard punchy saturation with sub-weight (-2.5 st) and tight decay for skeleton/zombie hits.

distant_fog_omen.name: Distant Through-the-Fog Omen
distant_fog_omen.feeling: Rolls off highs (950 Hz) and wraps the sound in deep forest canopy reflection so monsters or bells sound far away in the mist.

catacomb_echo.name: Cold Stone Catacomb Echo
catacomb_echo.feeling: Reflective stone walls with eerie mid-focus for underground ruins, shrines, and skeleton crypts.

abyssal_demonic_pact.name: Abyssal Void & Andras Pact
abyssal_demonic_pact.feeling: Drops pitch half an octave (-6 st) into a dark cavernous void tail for demonic whispers, relics, and Demon Time.

crisp_ethereal_relic.name: Sacred Star-Fire Shimmer
crisp_ethereal_relic.feeling: Lifts pitch (+3 st), clears low mud, and adds an airy shimmer tail for Moon Knight / Candora / light relics.

scene_recipes.title: 🌲 Scene 1: The Dark Forest Awakening (Exploration & Dread)
scene_recipes.target_feeling: Lonely, damp, watchful. The player should feel the cool midnight mist, hear their boots pressing into damp earth, and sense unseen eyes in the canopy.
scene_recipes.ambient_bed_primary: assets/audio/Free Fantasy SFX Pack By TomMusic/WAV Files/BGS Loops/Forest Night/Forest Night.wav
scene_recipes.ambient_bed_secondary: assets/audio/Free Fantasy SFX Pack By TomMusic/WAV Files/BGS Loops/Forest Night/Forest Night Rain.wav
how_to_mix: 1. Set 'Forest Night.wav' as your continuous room-tone bed at 40% volume.
2. Layer 'Forest Night Rain.wav' or 'dark-forest.ogg' at 25% volume with Low-Pass at 2400 Hz for damp air.
3. Bend footsteps ('Dirt Chain Run 1..5') with Pitch -1.5st and Low-Pass 2600 Hz so they thud into the soil instead of clicking.
4. Trigger 'Wendigo sounds.mp3' or 'DeepOne_Rumble.mp3' pitched down -4st with 45% Forest Reverb at rare intervals.

scene_recipes.title: 🔥 Scene 2: Memories of the Burning Village (Tragedy & Fury)
scene_recipes.target_feeling: Suffocating heat, grief, and irreversible doom. The fire should roar in the chest while distant bells toll.
scene_recipes.ambient_bed_secondary: assets/audio/Free Fantasy SFX Pack By TomMusic/WAV Files/SFX/Torch/Torch Loop.wav
how_to_mix: 1. Pitch 'Burning Fire.mp3' down -2st so it sounds like a massive roaring structure fire rather than a small campfire.
2. Layer 'Torch Loop.wav' unbent at 35% volume for close-up snapping embers.
3. Bend 'Ominous Bells of Doom.mp3' with Pitch -3st + Void Reverb (50%) when transitioning between comic panels.

scene_recipes.title: 👁️ Scene 3: The Whispering Grimoire & Andras Pact (Unholy Intimacy)
scene_recipes.target_feeling: Time slows down; the forest recedes into a suffocating void where only Andras's bargain and the pulsing runes exist.
scene_recipes.ambient_bed_secondary: assets/audio/Be Not Afraid UI/--Unholy/Souls/Unholy UI - Souls (4).wav
how_to_mix: 1. Duck forest ambience by 70% (low-pass at 600 Hz) as soon as the Grimoire opens.
2. Bring in 'Abyssal_Descent1.mp3' pitched down -4st as a sub-bass void bed.
3. Use 'Unholy UI - Souls (1..16)' pitched -3st for rune levitation and 'BNA_UI13_Long.wav' for pact confirmation.

scene_recipes.title: 🩸 Scene 4: Blood Zombie & Skeleton Horde Clash (Visceral Weight)
scene_recipes.target_feeling: Relentless iron, bone, and sinew. Every scythe swing feels heavy and dangerous; every hit cracks bone or tears armor.
scene_recipes.ambient_bed_primary: assets/audio/Free Fantasy SFX Pack By TomMusic/WAV Files/BGS Loops/Forest Night/Forest Night Storm.wav
scene_recipes.music_track: assets/audio/Combat Pack - vol 1/2. One Last Day on Earth - 110bpm - LOOP 52s.wav
how_to_mix: 1. Drive the encounter with 'One Last Day on Earth (110 BPM)' or escalate to 'Time For a Revenge (157 BPM)'.
2. Bend player scythe swings ('whoosh-cinematic' or 'Sword Attack 1..3') down -4st with 35% Drive.
3. Stack 'blade_hit_07.wav' + 'bone_breaking_03.wav' (delayed 15ms, pitched -2st) for Skeleton hits, and 'guts_and_gore_19.wav' for Blood Zombie hits.
